FOREIGN AFFAIRS SECTION.
4 - 2 - 1944.

COMPLAINT AGAINST VLADIMIR TATISCHEFF ( RUSSIAN ).
This is to report that the undersigned
received a complaint against Vladimir Tatischeff,
( Russian ) alleged count.
Mr Martin Stuercken, German, sub-manager of
Export Dept., Melchers & Co, 214 Kiukiang Road
reported the following:
Mr V. Tatischeff came to see him in his office
and made an offer to sell 10 bags of officially
saleable sugar. It was agreed that the purchase and
delivery be made on the same day at the latest at
1 p.m. It was on February 1st. The payment was
to be made on delivery of the cargo. V. Tatischeff
accepted these conditions but requested that
the firm should advance him CRB $12,000.00 to pay
for transportation. He duly issued a receipt which
is deposited at this office, against the payment of
the amount to him.
The cargo was not delivered, he did not
returned the money neither he came again himself
to the office of complainant.
On February 2nd the wife of Tatischeff came
to office of complainant to ask to give her 24 hours
to procure the money and to pay the office,
This time limit was granted to her but she did not
come during the period stipulated but sent in stead
one Mr Ronne ( Norwegian ). Mr Ronne requested
further extention of 24 hours which was granted again
However even after this additional extention the
money were not returned. Thus the complainant finds
to lodge a complaint with the police.

This are the correct
facts of the case.
....................
D.S.

外事股。
1944年2月4日。

针对弗拉基米尔·塔季谢夫（俄国人）的投诉。
兹报告，下述签署人收到一起针对弗拉基米尔·塔季谢夫（俄国人）涉嫌犯罪的投诉。
德国人马丁·斯图尔肯先生，美最时洋行（Melchers & Co.）出口部副经理，办公地址九江路214号，举报如下情况：
V. 塔季谢夫先生来到其办公室拜访，并提出出售10袋官方许可销售的白糖。双方约定，买卖及交货须于同日完成，最迟不超过下午1时。此事发生在2月1日。货款应在交货时支付。V. 塔季谢夫接受了这些条件，但要求该公司预付他中国储备银行券（CRB）12,000.00元，以支付运输费用。他随即出具了一张收据，作为收取该笔款项的凭证，该收据现存于本办公室。
货物并未交付，他既未退还钱款，也未再次亲自前往投诉人的办公室。
2月2日，塔季谢夫的妻子来到投诉人办公室，请求给予她24小时的时间去筹措资金并向该办公室付款。
这一时限获准给予她，但她在规定期限内并未前来，而是派了一位罗内先生（挪威人）前来代替。罗内先生请求再延长24小时，该请求再次获准。然而，即使在这段额外的延长期之后，钱款仍未归还。因此，投诉人决定向警方提出投诉。

以上为本案的确切事实。
....................
D.S.
